MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 15

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

6. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 11
   C. 15
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 1

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 5

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
